answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Re-attestations are stored in garden and nadir lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2674 identities would post 1147 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
